_note: Curated groups of parts makers and sellers often confuse, written by hand for Bharat Sourcer on 2026-10-06. Patterns are regular expressions over a compact part name: lowercase, '-' and '_' removed, other punctuation turned into spaces. A match is a warning to check the exact part, never a verified identity or a substitute recommendation.

groups.note: BMP280 measures temperature and pressure only; BME280 adds humidity. The breakout boards look the same and are often mislabelled.
0.96-inch OLEDs usually use the SSD1306 controller; many 1.3-inch modules use SH1106, which needs a different library.
AMS1117 regulators come in fixed 3.3 V and 5 V and adjustable versions that look identical; check the marking.
HC-SR04 needs a 5 V supply; HC-SR04P also runs at 3.3 V, which suits ESP32 and Pico builds.
DHT11 has a smaller range and lower accuracy than DHT22 (AM2302); they share a pinout but not their readings.
ESP32 variants (original, S2, S3, C3) differ in pins, USB and Bluetooth; code and boards are not always interchangeable.
A4988 and DRV8825 stepper drivers share a footprint but differ in current limit, microstepping and pin defaults.
WS2812B, WS2811 and SK6812 LEDs differ in timing, colour order or supply voltage; set the right type in code.
MPU6050 (6-axis), MPU6500 and MPU9250 (9-axis) boards look alike; libraries and chip IDs differ.
28BYJ-48 steppers come in 5 V and 12 V versions that look the same.
